title: NoTrample
description: A lightweight, modern, crop protection plugin to prevents players from accidentally destroying farmland.
body:
# NoTrample **NoTrample** is a lightweight, high-performance plugin designed to stop players from accidentally ruining farmland by jumping or landing on it. Instead of a full disable of the plugin, you can require players to hold a specific type of tool (like hoes or shovels) to bypass protection. This allows for intentional management of a farm while preventing any accidental trampling of it. --- ## How It Works NoTrample watches when players land on farmland and instantly cancels the trampling effect unless they are holding a designated tool, like a hoe. By utilizing Minecraft's native item tags, the plugin naturally supports all vanilla items and future game updates. --- ## Commands & Permissions NoTrample keeps things simple with just a single administrative command to manage the plugin on the fly. | Command | Description | Permission | Default | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `/nt reload`
*(or `/notrample reload`)* | Reloads the config, clears the cache, and applies changes instantly. | `notrample.reload` | Operators (OP) |
